items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I started playing with the whole Columbia band, the whole Columbia band, a cornet player called Tick Chambers.

ctx.x: Joe Johnson. Joe Johnson. Joe Johnson and Bunk and Buddy Beteete they all played by the same little style. So that kept me going. And so about 1915 I was close to 14 years old. I started playing with the whole Columbia band, the whole Columbia band, a cornet player called Tick Chambers. The band was getting ready to come north and so George Foster was in the band, Pop Foster, and they told him, says the kid uptown in Losing Avenue, play like Bunk, Lee Collins, why don't you give Lee Collins a chance and let him…
